MIDTERM TEST #1 (30%); Chapters 9-12; During in person class; Contract Interpretation: Classification of Contractual Provisions (Terms, Representations, Warranties and conditions), Parole Evidence Rule, Penalty Clauses, Privity, Vicarious Performance, Assignment, Discharge; Cases: Tilden Rent-a-Car v. Cases: Mallette v. Shulman, Prinzo V. Baycrest, Wilkinson v. Downton, Banyasz v. K-mart, Nelles v. Ontarion, Jones v. Tsige, Hill v. The Church of Scientology
